# Components registry

Source of truth for UI components. Regenerated by `bin/components_registry`.
**NEVER hand-edit this file.** Re-run the script after changing any component.

## AppShellComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `app-shell`
- **Template:** `app/components/app_shell_component/app_shell_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/app_shell_component_preview.rb`
- **Slots:** `navigation`
- **Examples:**

  - `default`:

    ```ruby
      def default
        render(AppShellComponent.new) do |shell|
          shell.with_navigation_content('<a class="text-body text-foreground" href="#">Visão geral</a>'.html_safe)
          '<p class="text-body text-foreground">Conteúdo principal</p>'.html_safe
        end
    ```


## AuthLayoutComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `auth-layout-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/auth_layout_component/auth_layout_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/auth_layout_component_preview.rb`
- **Slots:** `illustration`
- **Examples:**

  - `default`:

    ```ruby
      def default
        render(AuthLayoutComponent.new) do
          '<h1 class="text-display text-foreground">Acessar a plataforma</h1>'.html_safe
        end
    ```

  - `with_illustration`:

    ```ruby
      def with_illustration
        render(AuthLayoutComponent.new) do |auth|
          auth.with_illustration_content(
            '<div class="absolute inset-0 bg-primary"></div>'.html_safe,
          )
          '<h1 class="text-display text-foreground">Acessar a plataforma</h1>'.html_safe
        end
    ```


## ButtonComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `button-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/button_component/button_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/button_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `label` (key)
  - `variant` (key)
  - `size` (key)
  - `type` (key)
  - `disabled` (key)
  - `href` (key)
  - `classes` (key)
  - `data` (key)
  - `aria` (key)
- **SIZES:** `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `icon`
- **TYPES:** `button`, `submit`, `reset`
- **VARIANTS:** `default`, `outline`, `ghost`, `destructive`, `soft`, `link`
- **Slots:** `leading_icon`, `trailing_icon`
- **Examples:**

  - `as_link`:

    ```ruby
      def as_link
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Voltar ao painel", variant: :outline, href: "#"))
      end
    ```

  - `disabled_state`:

    ```ruby
      def disabled_state
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Aguardando…", disabled: true))
      end
    ```

  - `playground`:

    ```ruby
      def playground(variant: :default, size: :md, disabled: false, label: "Salvar alterações")
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: label, variant: variant, size: size, disabled: disabled))
      end
    ```

  - `with_leading_icon`:

    ```ruby
      def with_leading_icon
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Adicionar")) do |button|
          button.with_leading_icon(name: "plus", size: :sm)
        end
    ```


## CardComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `card-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/card_component/card_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/card_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `variant` (key)
  - `padding` (key)
  - `html_options` (keyrest)
- **PADDINGS:** `default`, `roomy`
- **VARIANTS:** `default`, `elevated`, `outlined`
- **Slots:** `footer`, `header`
- **Examples:**

  - `playground`:

    ```ruby
      def playground(variant: "default", padding: "default")
        render(CardComponent.new(variant: variant, padding: padding)) do |card|
          card.with_header { "Resumo da obra" }
          "O conteúdo do cartão respeita os tokens do design system."
        end
      end
    end
    ```


## EmptyStateComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `empty-state-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/empty_state_component/empty_state_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/empty_state_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `icon` (keyreq)
  - `title` (keyreq)
  - `description` (key)
  - `html_options` (keyrest)
- **Slots:** `action`
- **Examples:**

  - `default`:

    ```ruby
      def default
        render(EmptyStateComponent.new(icon: "blueprint", title: "Nenhuma obra cadastrada ainda",
                                       description: "Crie a primeira obra para começar a acompanhar o avanço."))
      end
    ```

  - `with_action`:

    ```ruby
      def with_action
        render(EmptyStateComponent.new(icon: "blueprint", title: "Nenhuma obra cadastrada ainda")) do |state|
          state.with_action do
            render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Cadastrar obra", href: "#"))
          end
        end
    ```

## ImageFrameComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `image-frame-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/image_frame_component/image_frame_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/image_frame_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `attachment` (keyreq)
  - `alt` (keyreq)
  - `ratio` (key)
  - `sizes` (key)
  - `classes` (key)
- **CLASSES:** `frame`, `image`, `fallback`
- **RATIOS:** `16/9`, `4/3`, `1/1`
- **RATIO_CLASSES:** `16/9`, `4/3`, `1/1`
- **WIDTHS:** `480`, `960`, `1440`
- **Slots:** `caption`
- **Examples:**

  - `four_by_three`:

    ```ruby
      def four_by_three
        render(ImageFrameComponent.new(attachment: analyzed_photo, alt: ALT, ratio: "4/3"))
      end
    ```

  - `playground`:

    ```ruby
      def playground
        render(ImageFrameComponent.new(attachment: analyzed_photo, alt: ALT))
      end
    ```

  - `processing`:

    ```ruby
      def processing
        render(ImageFrameComponent.new(attachment: pending_photo, alt: ALT))
      end
    ```

  - `square`:

    ```ruby
      def square
        render(ImageFrameComponent.new(attachment: analyzed_photo, alt: ALT, ratio: "1/1"))
      end
    ```

  - `with_caption`:

    ```ruby
      def with_caption
        render(ImageFrameComponent.new(attachment: analyzed_photo, alt: ALT)) do |frame|
          frame.with_caption { "12 de março de 2026 · Marina Duarte" }
        end
    ```

  - `without_attachment`:

    ```ruby
      def without_attachment
        render(ImageFrameComponent.new(attachment: nil, alt: ""))
      end
    ```


## InputComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `input-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/input_component/input_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/input_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `form` (keyreq)
  - `attribute` (keyreq)
  - `type` (key)
  - `options` (keyrest)
- **FIELD_HELPERS:** `text`, `email`, `password`, `number`, `tel`, `date`
- **TYPES:** `text`, `email`, `password`, `number`, `tel`, `date`, `textarea`
- **Examples:**

  - `default`:

    ```ruby
      def default
        render(InputComponent.new(form: form_builder, attribute: :email, type: "email",
                                  required: true, hint: "Usaremos este endereço para falar com você."))
      end
    ```


## PageHeaderComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `page-header-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/page_header_component/page_header_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/page_header_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `title` (keyreq)
  - `subtitle` (key)
  - `html_options` (keyrest)
- **Slots:** `actions`, `breadcrumbs`
- **Examples:**

  - `playground`:

    ```ruby
      def playground
        render(PageHeaderComponent.new(title: "Obras", subtitle: "Acompanhe o avanço de cada projeto."))
      end
    ```

  - `with_breadcrumbs_and_actions`:

    ```ruby
      def with_breadcrumbs_and_actions
        render(PageHeaderComponent.new(title: "Detalhes da obra")) do |header|
          header.with_breadcrumb(label: "Obras", href: "#")
          header.with_breadcrumb(label: "Detalhes")
          header.with_actions do
            render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Editar obra", variant: :outline, href: "#"))
          end
        end
    ```

- **Stimulus controller:** `progress-bar-component`

  - `value` (keyreq)
  - `target` (key)
  - `html_options` (keyrest)
- **KINDS:** `physical`, `funding`, `spending`
- **KIND_CONFIG:** `physical`, `funding`, `spending`
- **Examples:**

  - `funding`:

    ```ruby
      def funding
        render(ProgressBarComponent.new(kind: "funding", value: 184_000, target: 300_000))

      def physical
        render(ProgressBarComponent.new(kind: "physical", value: 62))
      end
    ```

  - `spending`:

## SelectComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `select-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/select_component/select_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/select_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `name` (keyreq)
  - `label` (keyreq)
  - `choices` (keyreq)
  - `selected` (key)
  - `include_blank` (key)
  - `html_options` (keyrest)
- **Examples:**

  - `default`:

    ```ruby
      def default
        render(SelectComponent.new(name: :status, label: "Situação", choices: STATUSES,
                                   include_blank: "Qualquer uma"))
      end
    ```

  - `with_a_choice_already_made`:

    ```ruby
      def with_a_choice_already_made
        render(SelectComponent.new(name: :status, label: "Situação", choices: STATUSES,
                                   selected: "in_progress", include_blank: "Qualquer uma"))
      end
    ```

  - `without_a_blank_option`:

    ```ruby
      def without_a_blank_option
        render(SelectComponent.new(name: :status, label: "Situação", choices: STATUSES))
      end
    ```

## TableComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `table-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/table_component/table_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/table_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `rows` (keyreq)
  - `caption` (keyreq)
  - `html_options` (keyrest)
- **ALIGNMENTS:** `left`, `center`, `right`
- **ALIGNMENT_CLASSES:** `left`, `center`, `right`
- **DIRECTIONS:** `ascending`, `descending`
- **Slots:** `columns`
- **Examples:**

  - `default`:

    ```ruby
      def default
        render(TableComponent.new(rows: rows, caption: "Obras cadastradas")) { |table| configure_columns(table) }
      end
    ```


## ToastComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `toast-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/toast_component/toast_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/toast_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `severity` (keyreq)
  - `message` (keyreq)
  - `classes` (key)
- **SEVERITIES:** `alert`, `notice`
- **Examples:**

  - `alert`:

    ```ruby
      def alert
        render ToastComponent.new(severity: :alert, message: t("sessions.create.failed"))
      end
    ```

  - `notice`:

    ```ruby
      def notice
        render ToastComponent.new(severity: :notice, message: t("passwords.create.sent"))
      end
    ```
